stem: Ravi is a 13-year-old student in a school in Pune. His teacher asks the class to suggest a healthy growth plan for adolescents. Which plan is the best choice for Ravi's healthy growth?

options.text: Eat a varied nutritious diet with proteins, carbohydrates, fats, vitamins and minerals, and take part in regular exercise and games
Eat a varied nutritious diet every day, but avoid all exercise and physical games because they are not needed
Eat only his favourite filling food such as rice and potatoes, with no need for other nutrients or exercise
Eat a varied nutritious diet and exercise only until he reaches adult height, then stop both

teacher.key_rationale: Adolescents are growing and need a balanced diet containing all nutrient groups together with regular exercise; only option A includes both. B drops the exercise condition, C drops nutrient variety and activity, D wrongly limits the need to the period before adult height.
